description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It is used to manage large or time-consuming tasks without blocking the UI, such as expanding tree nodes in a dashboard. The code includes the createProgressiveExpandController function and the useProgressiveExpand React hook, which manages UI state related to the progress of the batch processing.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with start and cancel methods, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) and provides methods to start processing from a list of items or cancel ongoing processing.
